summary.intent: Decide whether Phase 72 needed a discussion pass or could go straight to planning, reconcile todo drift across Phases 70/70.1/71/72/73, confirm 72/73 have no parallelizable independent scope, then plan+execute+ship Phase 72 followed by 73 — work that was interrupted by two live CI regressions on main needing diagnosis and fixes.
summary.outcome: Confirmed Phase 72 could skip discuss-phase; retired 8 stale Phase 71 todos to completed/, added zeroize-file-keys todo to Phase 72 and the 68.2 coderabbit backlog (web-scoped items only) to Phase 73's source lists; confirmed 72→73 must be sequential due to shared client.ai write-plane code; started Phase 72 CONTEXT.md before pausing for CI triage; diagnosed both CI regressions (desktop-e2e: FUSE seq=1 republish bug from Phase 71's anti-equivocation gate; web-e2e: stale test referencing pre-Phase-70.1 IndexedDB store names) and shipped the web-e2e test fix; desktop FUSE fix still outstanding.

repo: This repo retires todos by deleting/moving the file from pending/ to completed/, not by editing status fields — Phase 71 shipped (#599) without doing this for its 8 source todos, leaving them stranded in pending/ despite being fully addressed

ROADMAP.md phase entries declare explicit cross-phase dependencies (e.g. '73 depends on 72') that should be validated against actual file-level overlap rather than trusted blindly — in this case the dependency was real, not just conservative sequencing

Phase 70.1 collapsed two separate IndexedDB stores (generation-high-water, seq-high-water) into a single rotation-floor store (DB v2, keyed by nodeId) — downstream test helpers referencing old store names silently no-op rather than erroring

code.finding: Phase 71's D-05 anti-equivocation gate: same-sequence republish with a different CID is hard-rejected via BadRequestException; same-CID idempotent re-sign still succeeds. This is intentionally strict and the desktop-e2e regression fix should work around it on the FUSE side, not relax it.

publish_file_node hardcodes seq=1 on the first-publish branch gated only on 'inode cid empty' — a dropped/stale UploadComplete retry re-enters this branch with a fresh CID at seq=1, tripping the new anti-equivocation gate. Fix direction: resolve the IPNS name first; only treat as first-publish if genuinely absent, else fall through to the existing CAS bump path.

Test helper probed the pre-v2 store names (generation-high-water/seq-high-water), short-circuited before reading real data, and returned floors.generation as undefined — a stale-test bug, not a product durability regression.

Central write-plane code (getWriteBodyParams, write-plane helper dedup, buildSharedWriteContextFromState, publishNodeFn) is modified by both Phase 72 (fail-closed rewrite, helper dedup) and Phase 73 (SC#3 floor-gate, SC#4 refresh trigger) — the reason the phases can't run in parallel.

workflow: When multiple long-running verification/classification agents are dispatched in parallel, wait for their task-notifications rather than polling — notifications arrive automatically on completion

Before applying an agent-proposed patch, independently verify it against the real production schema/state (e.g. queried the actual IndexedDB DB version/store shape) rather than trusting the agent's read alone

When CI firefighting interrupts in-progress uncommitted planning work, stash it explicitly and switch to a clean branch off main for the fix, then restore the stash afterward — keeps unrelated uncommitted work from bleeding into fix commits

friction: Assistant initially checked the wrong directory when looking for retired/completed todos, requiring a redirect to the correct completed/ folder
Phase 72 CONTEXT.md drafting was interrupted mid-task by the user reporting live CI failures, requiring a context switch and stash of uncommitted planning work
Two independent CI regressions were live simultaneously on main from different recent phases (70.1 and 71), requiring separate diagnosis and separate fix branches
